fields.summary_ko.0: Fortinet (FTNT) declined 2.2% on the day due to Q3 service revenue guidance miss and has adjusted down 24% over one month from cyclically elevated 43.7x trailing P/E.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 revenue was $2.078B (+20.5% YoY) and basic EPS was $0.87 (+38.0% YoY), showing earnings growth, but 2026 service revenue guidance was lowered to $5.15B–$5.17B.
